name: Can I view a luxury property without completing buyer screening first?

mainEntity.name: Can I view a luxury property without completing buyer screening first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, access to view luxury properties, especially those that are occupied or highly exclusive, is contingent upon completing buyer screening. Sellers and their agents prioritize safety and privacy, ensuring only qualified and serious buyers are granted access. A practical tradeoff for buyers is that foregoing screening means potentially missing out on viewing desirable properties, as most listing agents will require this step to confirm genuine interest and financial capability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, you cannot view a luxury property without prior buyer screening to ensure privacy and qualification.
